The supplied measurements share one horizon and show no evidence requiring the 4- or 5-parameter coupled-memory ODE; acquiring an 8-row trajectory batch is unnecessary for the mapped bridge law.
The verified bridge mapping and saturating response shape favor the two-layer siphon family over uncoupled polynomial or logistic models.
